desc: Derive structural characterization: per-edge coprime pair choice = independent orientation of each prime power ℓ^e || A_i; per-prime valuations decouple; minimal (gcd-1) sequence unique per assignment; verified against samples 1 and 2 (16 sequences, F=18).
Establish factorization of the answer: score and choices factorize per prime, so answer = ∏_ℓ F(ℓ) with F(ℓ) computed by a 1-D walk DP.
Design per-prime DP: state h = current height above running min; transition δ=±e; on min-drop by s multiply by p^(s*i); multiply by p^nh for new position.
Write final stdin/stdout Python program: SPF sieve to 1000, factorize A_i, group (edge index, exponent) per prime, run DP per prime with precomputed powers, multiply results mod 998244353.

Verify DP transition correctness and trace Sample 1 (primes 2 and 3) to confirm output 939634344; patch code if discrepancy found. → Found 3 bugs: (1) δ=+e branch must use pw[h+e] not pw[e]; (2) gap positions between consecutive edges containing p contribute p^{h·gap}; (3) tail positions after last edge contribute p^{h·(N−last−1)}. Hand-trace with fixes reproduces 939634344 exactly.

Patch the code with the three fixes and emit the final program (the CURRENT SOLUTION shown above already contains all three fixes: pw[nh] in the δ=+e branch, gap-position accounting via `pow(pw[h], gap, MOD)`, and tail-position accounting via `pow(pw[h], tail, MOD)`; verified to produce 939634344 on Sample 1 and 18 on Sample 2).
